title: UFO programs hidden under the Department of Energy

tellings.quote: because I was told I think it was Chris Melon was telling me this that they hide things because anything nuclear would be national security.

plain: UFO programmes are said to be hidden inside the Department of Energy, the US agency in charge of nuclear weapons, because under the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, a US law on nuclear secrecy, anything nuclear counts as national security. Michels says he was told this by a man named Chris Mellon, though he is not completely sure it was Mellon. If true, it would explain how such programmes could stay out of public view.
